newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas to resume Galveston Bay drilling.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas to resume Galveston Bay drilling.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Co said Tuesday it intends to resume drilling its State Tract 331 1 well in Galveston Bay over the next five days.

On May 6, the company noted, it was forced to suspend drilling of the well as a result of 9,600 pounds per square inch surface pressure encountered from 15,400 feet depth, which collapsed the drillpipe. During subsequent pressure control operations, natural gas and 47 degree gravity condensate were returned to the surface.

The company said it believes the Vicksburg formation, encountered 400 feet high to the original well prognosis, was the source of the strong natural gas and condensate shows. Multiple shows were also encountered in shallower Frio sections of the well.

The 1,150 acre structure on which the State Tract 331 1 is being drilled is one of three similar structures that the Company intends to drill in Galveston Bay and adjacent coastal areas as tests of features it believes exhibit similar geology to sections in the nearby Chocolate Bayou field.
